摘要： 本研究针对 A 股市场的配对交易（Pairs Trading）策略，构建了一套 DQN + Actor-Critic 混合深度强化学习模型，并与传统 Z-score 基线策略进行系统对比。实验基于 27 对协整股票配对、1564 个交易日的历史数据，覆盖基建、医药、消费、金融、地产、新能源六大行业。结果表明，RL 模型平均总回报为 704.63 元，较基线（53.85 元）提升 1208%，夏普比率由 0.6482 升至 3.1881（+392%）；盈利配对占比 100%（27/27），回报标准差 221.02 元。
Abstract: This study develops a DQN + Actor-Critic hybrid deep reinforcement learning model for pairs trading in the Chinese A-share market, benchmarked against a traditional Z-score strategy. Experiments cover 27 cointegrated stock pairs across 1,564 trading days, spanning six sectors (Infrastructure, Pharmaceuticals, Consumer, Finance, Real Estate, New Energy). Results show the RL model achieves an average total return of ¥704.63, a +1208% improvement over the baseline (¥53.85), with the Sharpe ratio rising from 0.6482 to 3.1881 (+392%). All 27/27 pairs are profitable (100% win rate), with a return standard deviation of ¥221.02.
1. 项目背景与目标 Background & Objectives

配对交易是一种市场中性量化策略，通过同时做多被低估资产、做空被高估资产来获取统计套利收益，不依赖市场整体涨跌方向。传统 Z-score 方法依赖固定阈值，难以适应市场状态的动态变化；强化学习则可以自适应地调整决策策略。

Pairs trading is a market-neutral quantitative strategy that captures statistical arbitrage returns by simultaneously buying an undervalued asset and shorting an overvalued one, independent of overall market direction. Traditional Z-score methods rely on fixed thresholds and struggle to adapt to changing market conditions; reinforcement learning allows adaptive, state-dependent decision making.

研究目标 / Research Objectives：

  • 基于协整检验筛选 A 股高质量配对资产 / Screen high-quality cointegrated stock pairs from A-shares
  • 构建融合时序建模、市场状态识别和混合决策的 RL 模型 / Build an RL model integrating temporal encoding, market-state recognition and hybrid decision-making
  • 引入 A 股真实费率模型（含印花税）进行回测 / Backtest with realistic A-share transaction costs (including stamp duty)
  • 量化评估 RL 策略相对 Z-score 基线的性能增益 / Quantify RL strategy performance gains over the Z-score baseline

3. 方法论 Methodology
3.1 基线：Z-score 配对交易策略 Baseline: Z-score Pairs Trading Strategy

传统策略以固定阈值驱动开平仓决策：

The traditional strategy uses fixed thresholds to trigger entry and exit signals:

  • z-score > 1.0 → 做空资产1、做多资产2（价差偏高） / Short asset-1, long asset-2 (spread overvalued)
  • z-score < −1.0 → 做多资产1、做空资产2（价差偏低） / Long asset-1, short asset-2 (spread undervalued)
  • |z-score| < 0.0 → 平仓（均值回归） / Close position (mean reversion)
  • |z-score| > 2.5 → 强制止损 / Force stop-loss
3.2 改进模型：DQN + Actor-Critic 混合架构 Proposed Model: DQN + Actor-Critic Hybrid Architecture
图2：DQN + Actor-Critic 混合模型架构示意图 Fig.2: Architecture diagram of the DQN + Actor-Critic hybrid model

核心模块 / Key Modules：

① SharedEncoder（共享编码器 / Shared Encoder）
  • 双层 LSTM + LayerNorm / Two-layer LSTM + LayerNorm
  • 滑动序列窗口 seq_len = 10 / Sliding window length = 10
  • 捕捉价差时序动态特征 / Captures temporal dynamics of the spread
② MarketStateClassifier（市场状态识别 / Market-State Recognition）
  • 识别三类状态：均值回归 / 趋势 / 震荡 / 3 states: mean-reversion / trend / oscillation
  • 伪标签基于 z_velocity 和 z_volatility / Pseudo-labels from z_velocity & z_volatility
  • 动态调整决策权重 λ / Dynamically adjusts action-mixing weight λ
③ Actor（策略网络 / Policy Network）
  • 输出动作概率 π(a|s) / Outputs action probability distribution π(a|s)
  • 策略梯度优化 / Policy gradient optimisation
  • 熵正则化防止退化 / Entropy regularisation prevents collapse
④ Critic（价值网络 / Value Network）
  • 输出 Q 值 Q(s,a) / Outputs action-value Q(s,a)
  • Double DQN 消除高估偏差 / Double DQN reduces overestimation bias
  • PER Sum-Tree 优先经验回放 / PER Sum-Tree prioritised replay
3.3 联合损失函数 Joint Loss Function

模型采用四项加权损失，并根据市场状态动态调整 Actor / Critic 决策权重 λ：

The model uses four weighted losses, with the Actor/Critic mixing weight λ dynamically adjusted according to the recognised market state:

$$\mathcal{L} = \mathcal{L}_Q + 0.5\,\mathcal{L}_{\pi} + 0.3\,\mathcal{L}_m + 0.01\,\mathcal{L}_H$$
损失项 / Term 含义 / Meaning 权重 / Weight
$\mathcal{L}_Q$ Critic TD-error（Double DQN），PER加权 / Critic temporal-difference error with PER weighting 1.0
$\mathcal{L}_{\pi}$ Actor 策略梯度 $-\log\pi(a|s)\cdot A(s,a)$ / Policy-gradient loss 0.5
$\mathcal{L}_m$ 市场状态分类交叉熵（3类）/ Market-state classification cross-entropy 0.3
$\mathcal{L}_H$ 熵正则 $-\sum\pi\log\pi$，防过早确定性 / Entropy regularisation 0.01

最终动作 $= \lambda_Q \cdot Q(s,a) + (1-\lambda_Q)\cdot\pi(a|s)$，其中 $\lambda_Q$：均值回归 0.75 / 趋势 0.60 / 震荡 0.50。

Final action: $ \lambda_Q Q(s,a) + (1-\lambda_Q)\pi(a|s)$, with $\lambda_Q$ by market state: mean-reversion 0.75 / trend 0.60 / oscillation 0.50.

5. 实验结果 Experimental Results
5.1 实验设置说明 Experimental Protocol Notes

📋 本实验为严格量化回测，以下为交易规则及收益率计算说明 / Strict quantitative backtest — trading rules & ROI calculation:

持仓规模与费率 / Position Size & Costs
  • 建仓规模：多头/空头各 1 股 / Position size: 1 share per leg
  • 买入 0.032%（含过户费）/ Buy: 0.032%
  • 卖出 0.132%（+印花税）/ Sell: 0.132% (incl. stamp duty)
收益率计算 / ROI Calculation
  • 每对持仓成本 = 两股测试期均价之和 / Pair cost = sum of avg close prices
  • 单对 ROI = 净利润 / 持仓成本 × 100% / Pair ROI = net profit / cost × 100%
  • 组合 ROI = Σ净利润 / Σ持仓成本 × 100% / Portfolio ROI = Σprofit / Σcost × 100%
数据分割 / Data Splits
  • 训练 / Train: 2018-01-02 ~ 2022-03-14（1094 天）
  • 验证 / Val: 2022-03-15 ~ 2023-02-06（234 天）
  • 测试 / Test: 2023-02-07 ~ 2023-12-29（234 天）
回报说明 / Return Notes
  • 净利润 = Σ价格差 × ±1 − 手续费 / Net profit = Σ(price diff × ±1) − fees
  • 跨对绝对值不可直接比较（用 ROI） / Cross-pair absolute values not directly comparable — use ROI
  • 持仓成本范围：9.42 ~ 1690.68 ¥/对 (×179)

6. 结论与展望 Conclusion & Future Work

✅ 主要成果 Key Achievements

  • RL 模型平均回报较基线提升 1208% RL avg return +1208% vs baseline
  • 夏普比率大幅提升 +392%，风险调整收益显著改善 Sharpe ratio +392%; risk-adjusted return significantly improved
  • 27/27 配对全部盈利（盈利率 100%） All 27/27 pairs profitable (100% win rate)
  • 市场状态识别模块有效适配不同市场环境 Market-state classifier effectively adapts to varying conditions
  • PER + Double DQN 显著改善训练稳定性 PER + Double DQN markedly improves training stability

⚠️ 主要局限 Key Limitations

  • 平均最大回撤 48.80¥ 高于基线 33.38¥，回撤控制仍有空间 Avg max drawdown ¥48.80 exceeds baseline ¥33.38; drawdown control needs improvement
  • 回报标准差 221.02¥，不同配对收益分化显著 Return std ¥221.02; significant cross-pair return dispersion
  • A 股个人无法融券做空，实盘需改用 ETF 对冲 Retail short-selling is restricted in A-shares; live trading requires ETF hedging
  • 模型在样本内训练，存在过拟合风险 In-sample training raises overfitting concerns

🔬 未来方向 Future Directions

  • 奖励函数引入 CVaR 惩罚，显式控制回撤 Incorporate CVaR penalty in reward for explicit drawdown control
  • 改用 PPO / SAC 等 On-Policy 方法提升稳定性 Explore PPO / SAC on-policy methods for improved stability
  • 引入 Walk-Forward 训练防止过拟合 Walk-forward cross-validation to mitigate overfitting
  • 扩展行业覆盖，改善地产等弱均值回归板块 Expand sector coverage; improve performance in weak mean-reversion sectors (e.g., Real Estate)
